title: Species Pairing and State Permit List for Live Pet Health Guarantee Animals
content:
For each Live Pet Health Guarantee type, Tailwise Pet Co. lists the species combinations that may not be sold to share a habitat with the purchase, and the states where the species group needs a permit and is therefore not sold.

| Guarantee type | Species that may not be sold to share a habitat with the purchase | States where the species group needs a permit and is not sold |
|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | fish of incompatible temperament groups | none |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | reef-unsafe species with coral | none |
| Live Coral Guarantee | none listed | none |
| Small Animal Guarantee | rabbits with guinea pigs | California (CA), Hawaii (HI) |
| Bird Guarantee | parrots of mixed sizes | Hawaii (HI) |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | cohabiting males | Hawaii (HI), Georgia (GA) |

### State list read by state

| State | Guarantee types whose species group is not sold there |
|---|---|
| California (CA) | Small Animal Guarantee |
| Hawaii (HI) | Small Animal Guarantee, Bird Guarantee, Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee |
| Georgia (GA) | Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee |
| Any other state | none |

### Points of judgement

- No state restricts the Freshwater Fish, Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate or Live Coral Guarantee species groups.
- A bird may be sold in California and Georgia; a small animal may be sold in Georgia; a reptile or amphibian may be sold in California.
- The Live Coral Guarantee lists no pairing restriction of its own.
